title: Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus Member Rate on Freight Rebooking Fees
content:
**Member benefit statement - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders, Large Item Freight Delivery rebookings.**

The member rate applied to a freight rebooking fee is read from the customer's Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus membership: its tier, its status and the membership fees charged on its ledger.

- **Tailwise Plus Premier Annual**, in status active or pending downgrade, with a membership fee charged within the last 12 months: member rate 0.5 (50%).
- **Tailwise Plus Annual or Tailwise Plus Monthly**, in status active or pending downgrade, with a membership fee charged within the last 12 months: member rate 0.75 (75%).
- **Otherwise**: member rate 1.

A membership fee charge counts when fewer than 12 whole months separate its date from today.

### Condition combinations

| Tier | Status active or pending downgrade | Fee charged within 12 months | Member rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tailwise Plus Premier Annual | Yes | Yes | 0.5 |
| Tailwise Plus Premier Annual | Yes | No | 1 |
| Tailwise Plus Premier Annual | No (for example past due or closed) | any | 1 |
| Tailwise Plus Annual or Monthly | Yes | Yes | 0.75 |
| Tailwise Plus Annual or Monthly | Yes | No | 1 |
| Tailwise Plus Annual or Monthly | No | any | 1 |
| Pals Rewards Member, Insider or VIP, or no membership | - | - | 1 |

**Example (hypothetical).** A rebooking amount of $64.00 for an active Tailwise Plus Monthly member with a fee charged last month becomes $48.00 at the 0.75 rate, before any further multiplication and the final rounding.
